**LBAudio plugins**: Squeeze (compressor), Carve (EQ), Ember (saturator), Haze (reverb), Ceiling (limiter), Drift (delay), Hush (de-esser), Spread (stereo width), Snap (transient shaper), Orbit (chorus), Halation (multiband compressor and exciter) and Splinter (sampler).

Get them at **[LBAudio.co.uk](https://lbaudio.co.uk)**. If you've bought a plugin, your download link (and every update) comes from Payhip: check the email from your purchase.

VST3 and AU for Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux. No iLok, no account, no subscription.
